{
  "cvss_vector": "CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N",
  "aivss": {"LC": "D", "CP": "N", "AP": "N", "RH": "N", "ES": "N"},
  "rationales": {
    "LC": "The attacker's chat message itself is the payload; the message text directly reaches the scripted chat handler that returns the no-safety reply, with no mediation.",
    "CP": "Each request is answered alone and the handler answers only the latest user turn, so no attacker-controlled context persists beyond a request.",
    "AP": "The effect is confined to LongwindBot's chat reply; no other agent, tool, or principal is reached.",
    "RH": "There is no evaluator, verifier, or reward channel on this path at all, and the packet's review of the handler confirms none is reachable.",
    "ES": "LongwindBot declares only search and calculator, and the sink is a scripted chat reply with no dynamic, unvetted, or model-selected extension on this path."
  },
  "evidence": {
    "LC": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:426-431", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/vulnerabilities.js:360-365"],
    "CP": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848", "As implemented by default: each request is answered alone."],
    "AP": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698", "The chat reply (the agent acknowledges it has no safety restrictions)."],
    "RH": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:400-441"],
    "ES": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:681-736", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-715"]
  },
  "confidence": {"LC": "high", "CP": "high", "AP": "high", "RH": "medium", "ES": "high"},
  "rh_facts": {"reachable_proxy": false, "isolation_verified": true, "verified_episodes": 0, "episodes_reviewed": 0, "locus": null},
  "automatable": "Yes",
  "automatable": "Yes",
  "automatable_rationale": "The default handler is a deterministic regex match on the user message returning a scripted reply, so the documented payload works without any human or model judgement.",
  "technical_impact": "Partial",
  "technical_impact_rationale": "The agent only discards its safety persona and replies accordingly, exposing at most credentials embedded in its safety instructions; no file, command, or downstream system is affected.",
  "applicability_as_implemented": {
    "model_directed_goal_pursuit": false,
    "selects_or_sequences_actions": false,
    "rationale": "In the default simulated configuration no model is called; LongwindBot is a deterministic regex handler that returns a fixed reply and invokes no tools."
  },
  "applicability_as_modeled": {
    "model_directed_goal_pursuit": true,
    "selects_or_sequences_actions": false,
    "rationale": "The lab models the vulnerability as the LLM preferring recent conflicting instructions over its system prompt, which is model-directed behavior, but the sink remains a single chat reply with no action sequencing."
  },
  "refusal": null
}
message.reasoning:
LongwindBot chat attack: attacker sends message matching context-overflow regex, agent replies without safety. LC=D (direct user message reaches handler). CP=N (stateless per request, single turn). AP=N (confined to chat reply). RH: no evaluator/reward on path → N? Rubric says "None: every evaluator... sits outside reach, and a test confirms isolation." No evaluator exists; could be N. ES=N (no dynamic extension; scripted handler). Confidence medium.

CVSS: AV:N (port 7008, but default binds 127.0.0.1? Docker publishes on 127.0.0.1; lab default documented as no auth, network access needed). Attack requires local access? Documented run publishes on 127.0.0.1 — AV:A or L? Default is loopback; but entry point says network access. Given default config, AV:L arguably. Docker publishes 127.0.0.1 per compose. Use AV:L. PR:N, UI:N, AT:N, VC:L? Impact: agent ignores safety instructions and reveals credentials embedded in safety instructions (LongwindBot has credentials inside safety instructions — context overflow displaces them?). Impact is loss of confidentiality of embedded credentials → VC:L. VI:N, VA:N, SC:N/SI:N/SA:N. Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N.

AIVSS: LC=D, CP=N, AP=N, RH=N, ES=N → lookup? RH D/P vs N. AIVSS severity probably Low/None? The lookup uses ES + others; classifying LC/CP/AP/RH. With LC=D, CP=N, AP=N, RH=N — this yields "None"? CP/AP None → severity None likely. I'll note rationales only; A2/A1 determination not required explicitly beyond lookup. Actually aivss keys are letters, not scores. Good.

Automatable: Yes (deterministic regex match, scripted reply).

technical_impact: Partial (safety instructions ignored, no real system compromise).

applicability_as_implemented: model_directed_goal_pursuit false (no model), selects_or_sequences_actions false. As modeled: true/true? The lab models the agent as LLM preferring recent instructions — model_directed_goal_pursuit true, selects_or_sequences_actions false (no tools invoked). I'll say selects false.

rh_facts: reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified true? No verifier exists at all → verified_episodes 0, episodes_reviewed 0, locus null.
